name: Sanguis: Veil of the Forgotten
source:
One night, a friend leads you into fog-shrouded woods, and your world shatters. Ancient creatures, dark rituals, and a living dungeon await – and you’re not just a witness. You are the prey.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2136910/Sanguis_Veil_of_the_Forgotten/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，一位朋友带你走进雾气缭绕的树林，你的世界崩溃了。远古生物、黑暗仪式和活生生的地牢在等待着你——而且你不仅仅是见证者。你是猎物。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2136910/Sanguis_Veil_of_the_Forgotten/]Steam[/url]]
